For R2 & R3 : Mr.N.Naveen Kumar  Government Advocate  ORDER The relief sought for in the present writ petition is to direct the respondent 2, 3 and 4 to consider the representation submitted by the writ petitioner on 27.02.2023 to fix fair price to the land acquired from the petitioner.
2. The learned counsel for the petitioner states that the land belonging to the petitioner was acquired for public projects.
However, the compensation fixed was inadequate and therefore, the petitioner submitted a representation to fix a fair price and grant compensation accordingly.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.
The petitioner is entitled to seek enhancement of compensation under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act.
In this regard the petitioner has to approach the competent authority for adjudication and for determination of just compensation in accordance with the provisions of the Act.
4. Mere representation in this regard would be insufficient to resolve the issues.

Therefore, the petitioner is at liberty to file an appropriate application / petition under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act before the competent authorities seeking enhancement of compensation or to redress any other grievances, if exists.
5. With this liberty, this Writ Petition stands disposed of.
No costs.
